69782-a-southern-cross-fairy-tale.title: Fairy Tale
69782-a-southern-cross-fairy-tale.creator: KATE McCOSH CLARK
69782-a-southern-cross-fairy-tale.description: A book by KATE McCOSH CLARK. The cawing rooks fly to their nests;  Again the song-birds hush their lay;  O’er all the world a stillness rests,  And twilight shadows dance and play. The book is closed, hands folded o’er,  The work, that rests the while, undone;  See! glad young faces at the door,  And hark! the peals of mirth and fun.

arxiv-2404-18813.title: Safe Reach Set Computation via Neural Barrier Certificates footnoteinfo
arxiv-2404-18813.creator: Alessandro Abate, Sergiy Bogomolov, Alec Edwards, Kostiantyn Potomkin, Sadegh Soudjani, Paolo Zuliani
arxiv-2404-18813.description: Abstract We present a novel technique for online safety verification of autonomous systems, which performs reachability analysis efficiently for both bounded and unbounded horizons by employing neural barrier certificates. Our approach uses barrier certificates given by parameterized neural networks that depend on a given initial set, unsafe sets, and time horizon.

arxiv-2410-18245.title: Pasting and stability in convergence spaces
arxiv-2410-18245.creator: Renan M. Mezabarba, Rodrigo S. Monteiro, Thales F. V. Paiva
arxiv-2410-18245.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Renan M. Mezabarba, Rodrigo S. Monteiro, Thales F. V. Paiva. We prove a pasting lemma for locally finite closed covers of convergence spaces with limit codomains. We also show how the validity of such lemmas characterizes limit spaces. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 54A20; Secondary 54A05,54C05 Introduction The study of convergence spaces as generalizations of topological spaces goes back to Choquet’s introduction of pseudotopologies and pretopologies [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2508-11077.title: Explosions of pulsating red supergiants: a natural pathway for the diversity of Type II-P/L supernovae
arxiv-2508-11077.creator: V.A. Bronner, E. Laplace, F.R.N. Schneider, Ph. Podsiadlowski
arxiv-2508-11077.description: Abstract Red supergiants (RSGs), which are progenitors of hydrogen-rich Type II supernovae (SNe), have been known to pulsate from both observations and theory. The pulsations can be present at core collapse and affect the resulting SN. However, SN light curve models of such RSGs commonly use hydrostatic progenitor models and ignore pulsations.

arxiv-2508-19446.title: Maximal estimates for orthonormal systems of wave equations
arxiv-2508-19446.creator: Shinya Kinoshita, Hyerim Ko, Shobu Shiraki
arxiv-2508-19446.description: Abstract . This paper investigates maximal estimates of the wave operators for orthonormal families of initial data. We extend the classical maximal estimates for the wave operator by making partial progress on maximal estimates for orthonormal systems in low dimensions.

arxiv-2511-16360.title: On the Convex Interpolation for Linear Operators
arxiv-2511-16360.creator: Nizar Bousselmi, Zhicheng Deng, Jie Lu, François Glineur, Julien M. Hendrickx
arxiv-2511-16360.description: Abstract The worst-case performance of an optimization method on a problem class can be analyzed using a finite description of the problem class, known as interpolation conditions. In this work, we study interpolation conditions for linear operators given scalar products between discrete inputs and outputs.

pmc-10804302.title: Evaluation and Comparison of Nutritional Status According to Area of Residence and Type of Institute, its Effect on Plaque and Gingival Status: A Comparative Longitudinal Study
pmc-10804302.creator: Anupama G Gaur, Meenakshi Sharma, Rajesh Sharma, Nitin Gautam
pmc-10804302.description: Need of the studySchoolchildren constitute about 113.8 million (2000–2001 census) population of India and around 11,413,000 comprises schoolchildren in Rajasthan (2000–2001 census), with overall 2.4% children suffering from dietary inadequacies. pmc-11487805.title: Barriers and facilitators to cervical cancer screening among under- and neverscreened women in Flanders, Belgium – a qualitative study on community and healthcare providers’ perspectives
pmc-11487805.creator: Bo Verberckmoes, Elien De Paepe, Janne De Vestele, Ana Gama, Ines Keygnaert, Heleen Vermandere, Olivier Degomme
pmc-11487805.description: BackgroundCervical cancer is detectable and preventable in premalignant stages. In 2013, a population-based cervical cancer screening (CCS) programme was set up in Flanders (Belgium) promoting screening by means of sending reminder letters. Yet, in 2021, only a CCS coverage of 63.6% has been reached, which is just a bare increase since the implementation of the programme (62.

pmc-11654014.title: The F204S mutation in adrenodoxin oxidoreductase drives salinomycin resistance in Eimeria tenella
pmc-11654014.creator: Pei Sun, Chaoyue Wang, Fujie Xie, Linlin Chen, Yuanyuan Zhang, Xinming Tang, Dandan Hu, Yang Gao, Ning Zhang, Zhenkai Hao, Yonglan Yu, Jingxia Suo, Xun Suo, Xianyong Liu
pmc-11654014.description: Salinomycin is a polyether ionophore widely used for the treatment of coccidiosis in poultry. However, the emergence of coccidia strains resistant to salinomycin presents challenges for control efforts, and the mechanisms underlying this resistance in Eimeria remain inadequately understood. In this study, 78 stable salinomycin-resistant strains were generated through experimental evolution approaches.

pmc-11895796.title: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) Protocol for Craniotomy Patients: A Systematic Review
pmc-11895796.creator: Masood Zangi, Mahsa Asadi Anar, Mahdi Amirdosara, Majid Mokhtari, Reza Goharani, Sara Sanei Moghaddam, Omidvar Rezaei, Seyede Hamideh Hashemiyazdi, Mohammadreza Hajiesmaeili
pmc-11895796.description: ContextThe enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocol is a multidisciplinary approach aimed at improving surgical outcomes, reducing complications, minimizing hospital stays, and lowering healthcare costs. ObjectivesThis study assesses the impact of the ERAS protocol on elective craniotomies, a routine procedure in neurosurgery.MethodsA comprehensive search across PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science identified 562 articles.

pmc-12654417.title: Unlocking the Therapeutic Potential of Ellagitannins: A Comprehensive Review of Key Representatives
pmc-12654417.creator: Rositsa Mihaylova, Viktoria Elincheva, Georgi Momekov, Rumyana Simeonova, Ewa Skała, Agnieszka Kicel
pmc-12654417.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The present review offers a comprehensive synthesis of the structural diversity, natural occurrence, and therapeutic promise of key ellagitannins (punicalagin, sanguiin H-6, corilagin, geraniin, oenothein B, chebulagic, and chebulinic acids) within the hydrolyzable ellagitannin pool. Distributed in medicinal and dietary plants long used in traditional medicine, ellagitannin-rich species serve as sources of both complex polyphenolic scaffolds and their bioactive metabolites, urolithins, which mediate many of their health-promoting effects.

pmc-12702116.title: Optimizing methane flux prediction and key feature identification based on a novel hybrid machine learning model
pmc-12702116.creator: Xinqin Gu, Li Yao, Xiang Xiao, Lifeng Wu, Haofeng Yu
pmc-12702116.description: SummaryNatural landscape methane (CH4) emissions account for half of the global total, yet their quantification remains challenging due to high measurement costs and ecosystem complexity. In this study, the performance of three machine learning models, XGBoost (XGB), random forest (RF) and support vector machine (SVM) were assessed, to predict CH4 fluxes, using data from 36 FLUXNET-CH4 sites.

pmc-12748921.title: Characterization of a new specific mPGES-1 inhibitor in cardiovascular system
pmc-12748921.creator: Xinchun Lin, Huiying Feng, Jin-Rui Zhang, Malarvizhi Gurusamy, Saeed Nasseri, Anton Pekcec, Dongmei Wu
pmc-12748921.description: This study investigates the effects of BI 1,029,539 (GS-248 or Vipoglanstat), a novel selective inhibitor of human microsomal prostaglandin E synthase-1 (mPGES-1), in experimental models of myocardial infarction and vascular injury using transgenic mice constitutively expressing the humanized mPGES-1 (Ptges) allele.

pmc-12812808.title: A rare case of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma masquerading as Guillain Barre syndrome, Warburg phenomenon and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
pmc-12812808.creator: Anupama Kurup, Deepak Charles
pmc-12812808.description: We report a case of pyrexia of unknown origin presenting with lactic acidosis and hypoglycaemia. He further developed Guillain–Barre syndrome (GBS) and Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). The bone marrow biopsy ultimately reported Diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL). A 74-year-old gentleman visited the hospital in January 2024 with a fever since 2 weeks.

pmc-12882005.title: Barriers to Cervical Cancer Screening through Pap Smear Examination among Women Attending the Gynecology Polyclinic at Dr. Zainoel Abidin General Hospital in 2024: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12882005.creator: Munizar Munizar, Hibban Ar Royan Royan, Febrina Yolanda
pmc-12882005.description: Background: Cervical cancer remains the fourth most common cancer among women globally and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Despite the availability of effective screening methods such as the Pap smear, screening uptake remains suboptimal. Barriers such as limited awareness, socioeconomic challenges, cultural beliefs, and inadequate access to healthcare services contribute to this gap.

pmc-13185882.title: Single‐Cell Transcriptomics Reveals FLS2‐Dependent Hypoxia Signaling and ERF13‐Mediated Transcription During flg22‐Triggered Immunity
pmc-13185882.creator: Yaping Zhou, Aizhi Qin, Mengfan Li, Qianli Zhao, Luyao Kong, Lulu Yan, Chunyang Li, Hao Liu, Yinpeng Zhang, Jiani Long, Mengyu Liao, Mengmeng Zhou, Xiaoli Fan, Baozhen Wang, Wenxuan Kang, Shui Wang, Zhixin Liu, Xuwu Sun
pmc-13185882.description: The flagellin peptide flg22 activates FLAGELLIN‐SENSING 2 (FLS2)‐mediated immunity in Arabidopsis, leading to growth inhibition and oxidative burst. While these responses are well‐studied, their cell‐type‐specific regulation remains poorly understood. Using single‐cell RNA sequencing, genetics, and phenotyping, we systematically mapped flg22‐induced responses. flg22 suppressed growth and elevated reactive oxygen species (ROS) in wild‐type, but not in fls2 mutants.

pmc-13348645.title: Developmental and dynamic systems: insights for sex/gender research
pmc-13348645.creator: Giordana Grossi, Annie Duchesne, Donna L. Maney
pmc-13348645.description: Recent work incorporating gender into sex differences research has complicated the interpretation of both physiological and behavioral differences between women and men, which are traditionally interpreted as driven by “biological” sex-related variables. Alternative conceptualizations have been proposed to capture the complex relationship between sex and gender, such as sex/gender entanglement.

pmc-13469111.title: The influence of potassium post-deposition treatments on grain boundaries and surfaces of Cu(In,Ga)Se2 absorbers
pmc-13469111.creator: Evandro Martin Lanzoni, Omar Ramírez, Muhammad Uzair Farooq, Oana Cojocaru-Mirédin, Jean-Nicolas Audinot, Tom Wirtz, Susanne Siebentritt, Alex Redinger
pmc-13469111.description: Alkali metal post-deposition treatments (PDTs) have played a pivotal role in the development of high-efficiency Cu(In,Ga)Se2 thin film solar cells. The PDTs impact the near-surface region of the absorbers, the grain boundaries, and the bulk. Since Cu(In,Ga)Se2 solar cells are polycrystalline, the investigations turn out to be very challenging as each grain/grain boundary is affected slightly differently by the PDTs.

pmc-13533388.title: Characterization of METTL3/14-mediated m6A modification in human transcriptome using Nanopore direct RNA sequencing
pmc-13533388.creator: Emily Kurtyan, Andrew J. Stein, Kelly J. Abdalla, Zhangerjiao Yuan, Miten Jain, Fadia Ibrahim
pmc-13533388.description: Post-transcriptional RNA modifications modulate diverse aspects of RNA metabolism. N6-methyladenosine (m6A), one of the most abundant internal RNA modifications, is deposited by the core methyltransferase complex, METTL3 and METTL14. Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platform permits direct, single RNA molecule sequencing while preserving native modifications. However, without rigorous benchmarking, the accuracy and reproducibility of modification detection remain uncertain.

pmc-13598488.title: Morphology and molecular phylogeny of a new soil stichotrichid ciliate, Circinella granulifera sp. nov. (Alveolata, Ciliophora)
pmc-13598488.creator: Lijian Liao, Hongyue Song, Xiaozhong Hu
pmc-13598488.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The morphology and molecular characterisation of a novel soil stichotrichid ciliate, Circinella granuliferasp. nov., discovered in Ganzhou, southeastern China, were investigated using light microscopy of live and protargol-impregnated specimens, as well as ribosomal gene sequencing methods.
